title.why: Release names both bills; title is descriptive, not an official bill title (noted by extractor).

status.why: Signed 9 Sep 2026; effective date not stored, but any non-urgency California statute signed in Sep 2026 is not in force before 1 Jan 2027, so 'Adopted, not yet in force' holds as of today.

date_last_updated.why: null is right: the 18 Sep EO is a separate instrument (US-CA-09), not an amendment of these laws.

official_identifier.why: The record value carries a process remark '(as cited in EO N-9-26)' and an unquoted session label, which breaks the rule that the identifier is a citable number and not a description. The bill numbers and Government Code sections are supported.

fix.value: California Senate Bill 813 and Assembly Bill 1405; Government Code secs. 8898.1 and 11549.82

evidence.quote: Governor Gavin Newsom today signed legislation (Senate Bill 813 and Assembly Bill 1405)
complete the requirements of Section 8898.1 of the Government Code
shall complete the requirements of subdivision (a) of Section 11549.82 of the Government Code

legal_force.why: Release describes a signed law; EO text says IVO criteria are 'required by law'.

notes.why: EO N-9-26 deadlines (1 May 2027 for s. 8898.1 and IVO criteria; 1 Dec 2027 for s. 11549.82(a)) and 'signed 9 Sep 2026' match the stored text.

verification.note.why: Accurate; says the leginfo pages could not be stored.

summary_claims.claim: SB 813 (McNerney) frames independent verification organizations that can assess AI models and systems for compliance with state law
AB 1405 (Bauer-Kahan) creates a state registry of AI auditors with independence, transparency and integrity standards

scope.note: State law on AI evaluation and auditing.

note: Updates are well supported. The one fix cleans official_identifier by dropping the source remark and the unquoted session label, with quotes from stored text. A web search (secondary sources only) suggests SB 813 is Chapter 179, Statutes of 2026 with a 1 Jan 2027 operative date; no official page was found, so nothing is proposed from it. date_in_force stays null.
